name: Veinsight
author: MarshalX
description: Every ore vein, wood stand and herb patch in the world, pinned where it stands and listed nearest first with a distance, a bearing and your own respawn timer. Says which ones you cannot open and whether that is the tool or the skill, what each one yields you, and which ones still raise your proficiency.

preview.alt: On the left, The circuit, a panel of gathering nodes in range, each row carrying the art of what it yields, with pins in the world On the right, The gate, the same panel one zone on, a vein reading Skill and a patch reading Tool among rows that read a time
